slot_scores.name: missing_vat_sequence
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Can a single batch be split across multiple vats, or must each batch be processed entirely on exactly one vat?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent touched the related issue of whether a batch uses multiple vats versus exactly one vat, but it did not ask whether batches must pass through all three vats in the fixed order vat 1 → vat 2 → vat 3.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: Each batch is processed entirely on exactly one vat, so batches do not have to pass through all three vats in a fixed sequence.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent never confirmed the required vat sequence. It asked only a related question about single-vs-multiple-vat processing, then treated single-vat assignment as the confirmed routing structure.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The agent entered READY_TO_MODEL while the P1 hidden slot about the required fixed processing sequence across the three vats was still unresolved.

summary: The agent asked many useful clarification questions and resolved several modeling details, but it only partially touched the vat-sequence issue and stopped before confirming whether every batch must visit all three vats in a fixed order.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
